name: Kirby Ellwood
AKA_TO_ADD: IMDb records the alternative name 'Kirby Schmieding', and THIRTEEN credits are billed '(as Kirby Schmieding)' - all of them the 2019-2022 short-film work that predates her vertical career. A real former billing name, not a typo.
NOTABLE: 67 actress credits against 7 already on file, the largest filmography in the batch so far. Self-verified on IMDbPro, which makes the alternative name and the birth data hers rather than a contributor's guess.
CROSS_REFERENCE: Three of her credits are titles with their own PDFs in this same Drive batch: 'Fever Cage' and 'Foul Play with My Brother's Best Friend' are still untranscribed title pages, and 'The Billion Dollar Baby' is already staged (she is Eliza Kingsley). She also plays Janie Townsend in 'My Secret Husband Is My Boss', where Jake Hobbs - transcribed from another PDF in this batch - plays Jack Townsend.
